landing.pageTitle: PUMOPOKUS — a Pomodoro timer for Filipino students

intro.title: A Pomodoro timer for focused study
intro.lead: PUMOPOKUS is a free online Pomodoro timer built for students who want to focus without the fuss. Pick a session, press start, and let the timer hold the space for you.
intro.description: The name is a playful mix of pomodoro and pokus—focus. It works without an account, on phone or laptop, and remembers your settings on this device.

about.title: What is PUMOPOKUS?
paragraphs: PUMOPOKUS is a calm, colorful Pomodoro timer for students. It keeps the essentials in one place: focus sessions, short breaks, long breaks, and a soft chime when time is up.
Everything is adjustable. Set the lengths that fit your reading, review, or problem-set session, choose light or dark, and switch between English and Filipino. No sign-up, no feed, no extra noise.

technique.title: What is the Pomodoro Technique?
paragraphs: The Pomodoro Technique is a time-management method developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. It breaks work into short, timed focus sessions separated by brief breaks.
The classic rhythm is 25 minutes of focus, a 5-minute break, and a longer break after four focus sessions. The name comes from the tomato-shaped kitchen timer Cirillo used as a student.
The method is a guide, not a rule. PUMOPOKUS lets you change the lengths so the rhythm fits the way you study.

how.title: How to use PUMOPOKUS
how.intro: Everything you need is on the timer screen. These five steps are enough to begin.

steps.title: Choose a session
steps.body: Pick Pomodoro for focus, Short break for a quick reset, or Long break when you need more time away.

steps.title: Set your rhythm
steps.body: Open Settings to adjust session lengths and how many focus sessions come before a long break.

steps.title: Start the timer
steps.body: Press Start or the Space bar. Focus on one task until the chime plays.

steps.title: Take the break
steps.body: Step away for a short break. After your chosen number of focus sessions, take a longer one.

steps.title: Repeat and reset
steps.body: Start the next session when you are ready. Your preferences are saved on this device.

features.title: Basic features
items: Timestamp-based timer that stays accurate in background tabs
Custom focus, short-break, and long-break lengths
Adjustable long-break interval, auto-start, and automatic mode changes
Soft end-of-session chime and a countdown in the tab title
Light, dark, and system themes
English and Filipino interface
Tasks with subject tags, estimates, and a reward quote after each focus session
A daily focus streak and a 26-week activity heatmap
Weekly and subject reports with an exam countdown
Ambient study sounds, generated on your device
Light data mode that saves data and battery
Keyboard support and a mobile-first layout
Settings and tasks saved locally on your device
